title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for chronic kidney disease.

HPI
The patient is a 68-year-old male presenting for a routine follow-up of his chronic kidney disease. He currently reports feeling well, with no acute complaints of fatigue, edema, or shortness of breath. He is adherent to his current medication regimen. He notes that his blood pressure has been stable at home. He is aware of his stage 5 status and is here to monitor laboratory values and manage his hypertension.

Medication List
Lisinopril 20mg daily
Hydrochlorothiazide 12.5mg daily

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented x3. He appears in no acute distress. Skin is clear without significant edema. Heart sounds are regular with no murmurs. Lungs are clear to auscultation. Blood pressure is 138/82 mmHg.

Assessment
1. Chronic kidney disease, stage 5.
2. Hypertension.

Plan
Continue current medications for hypertension and CKD. Order a metabolic panel and serum creatinine to monitor renal function. Follow up in three months for a repeat laboratory evaluation and blood pressure check.
explanations: Hypertension with CKD stage 5 or ESRD: I12.0, plus N18.5/N18.6.
CKD stage 5 (not documented as ESRD): N18.5.

distractors.why: I12.9 is for stage 1-4 or unspecified CKD.
The classification presumes a link between hypertension and CKD.
